title: 情報工学専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Information and Computer Science Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: LEGO SPIKE + Raspberry Pi 2.Developing embedded system 3.Android programming 4.UI and APIs 5.Solution proposal
educationalGoal: - Students will acquire knowledge and skills in deep learning by developing and running an autonomous driving program that connects image data obtained from a camera attached to a robot car built using LEGO SPIKE and a Raspberry Pi with motor control. - Students will also acquire knowledge and skills for developing Android applications using various UI and APIs and propose valuable IT solutions.
advice: Overview of this class: [Developing autonomous driving programs for LEGO SPIKE with Raspberry Pi] 1) Introduction of the LEGO SPIKE + Raspberry Pi robot and setup of the development environments for SPIKE and Raspberry Pi (Python, Visual Studio Code, and Google Colaboratory). 2) Basic motions and control methods of the LEGO SPIKE + Raspberry Pi robot. 3) Implementation of autonomous driving using image recognition techniques. 4) Implementation of autonomous driving using convolutional neural networks. 5) Implementation of advanced autonomous driving tasks and demonstration of development results. [Developing Android apps] 6) Introduction of development environment and basic Android programming. 7) Android programming using various UIs. 8) Android programming using APIs and proposing an IT solution. 9) Android programming using “Intent” and implementation of the IT solution. 10) Presentation on the IT solution
books: Required Materials will be provided in the class.
requiredKnowledge: - Review Linux command-line operations and Python programming. - Review basic mechanisms of computer networks (TCP/IP). - Review the methods of group development.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the principles of autonomous driving using a LEGO SPIKE + Raspberry Pi robot.
Be able to prepare a development environment for the LEGO SPIKE + Raspberry Pi robot and develop advanced applic
Be able to develop basic Android apps using a proper UI.
Be able to develop useful Android apps using proper APIs.
Be able to propose valuable IT solutions with Android apps.

achievementLevels.ideal: [Developing control programs for LEGO SPIKE+RasPi] - Students with ideal achievement levels can design and implement practical control programs for a robot car using LEGO SPIKE and a RasPi, explain advanced mechanisms of robot car control systems, and design autonomous driving models based on image recognition and deep learning. [Developing Android apps] -Students with ideal achievement levels can implement Android apps realizing high usability using various UIs and APIs and they can also understand the customer needs sufficiently and deploy IT solutions based on them, as well as present them to customers in a comprehensive way.
achievementLevels.standard: [Developing control programs for LEGO SPIKE+RasPi] -Students with standard achievement levels can implement practical control programs for a robot car using LEGO SPIKE and a RasPi, explain mechanisms of robot car control systems, and design autonomous driving models based on deep learning. [Developing Android apps] -Students with standard achievement levels can implement basic Android apps using online documents for developers and they can also understand what IT solutions are applicable and acquire the basic skills for proposing them.
